name: In-Process VCS Repository Inspection
description: Performs fast, in-process repository tree walks, SHA hashing, and change detection without spawning external subprocesses or relying on host git installations.
recommendations: Avoid spawning external 'git' processes for tree traversal, diffing, or status verification.
Use in-process hash digests (SHA-256 / BLAKE3) and typed filesystem walkers to preserve deterministic sandbox execution.
Inject workspace root and repository path configurations explicitly via WorkspacePathsConfig.
